newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: WIFO keeps 1996 Austria GDP forecast at 0.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: WIFO keeps 1996 Austria GDP forecast at 0.7 pct.

text.p: Austria's leading research body WIFO will stick to its original pessimistic forecast of 0.7-percent GDP growth in 1996 and one percent in 1997, Austrian radio said on Wednesday.
WIFO will present its report on Friday.
The economic body, whose estimates form the basis of government policy, predicts inflation will remain at 1.7 percent this year and next, compared to 2.2 percent in 1995.
Unemployment is expected to show a modest decline.
Hopes are now pinned on private consumer spending to boost growth, the report said, but more problems were seen in the tourism sector. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
